messages:
maria: FYI planning a midnight (UTC) soft-reboot window for EU edge backplane firmware. Target: 00:30-01:15 UTC. Low traffic but we need coord with Dedicated pools and routing.
cheng: timeline? will this cordon nodes or full rack reboots?
sam: soft reboot + NIC firmware restart on half the racks in eu-west3. We cordon then drain tenants (graceful) -> reboot -> warm KV cache seed.
anita: which pools are affected? any Dedicated customers hit?
maria: affecting edge-saturn pools: saturn-eu-a/b. Dedicated reserved capacity in those racks will be drained to standby pools. SLA impacts minimal but flagging sales.
leo: @maria add canary group? prefer 2 racks first, then roll. Also sequence to avoid exhausting low-latency hosts.
maria: yes canary = rack-3/rack-7. If canary OK for 30m proceed with remaining cohort.
ops-bot: Incident template created: INC-2026-042-EO (scheduled maint). Notifying customers in enterprise-list.
infra-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. Will monitor packet loss and P95 gen latency.
cheng: pre-check list please. I'll run capacity hedge and backfill plan.
maria: checklist (short):
- pre-seed KV cache for saturn pools: run kv_preheat --pool saturn-eu --keys 2000
- increase batch_size limit to 64ms for canary only (temporary) in runtime routing
- update routing policy: prefer eu-east fallback for long seqs
- set rollback policy: immediate stop & reinstate nodes if p95 > 1.5x baseline
- customer comms: sales + infra-notify
sam: commands:
```
# cordon and drain
redctl node cordon rack-7
redctl job drain rack-7 --grace 120
# kv preheat
redctl kv preheat --pool saturn-eu --seed-file /opt/seed/kv-jan24.json
```
anita: cost question — draining to standby uses burst capacity. How much extra? estimate?
cheng: estimate ~4 GPU-hours per rack during warmbackfill, plus small egress to fill KV caches. Budget ~0.5% of nightly usage for eu region.
leo: note: Dedicated customers with pinned model versions — we need to ensure compatible quantization variants on fallback region; otherwise fallback will use hosted variant and might change responses.
maria: good catch. We'll add a routing override for pinned tenants: route pinned-* -> local-standby if available else hold until post-maint.
infra-oncall: monitoring hooks: enable trace sampling for model routes and set alert: eu-p95 > 700ms -> pager.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: rolling reboot job scheduled at 1798881000 (ETA after canary). Will post updates.
sam: during canary annotate metrics with tag maint.canary=rack-3
cheng: I'll run a dry run tonight on staging to validate kv preheat script and drain. Ping if anything fails.
maria: comms plan: post to #customer-comm and #announcements 2h before, update 15m before start. Anita please review customer note.
anita: on it. will include note about minimal SLA impact and routing fallback behavior.
leo: if any unexpected packet drops, abort and revert NIC firmware via bmc rollback. keep BMC window open.
infra-oncall: i'll be watching netflow + gpu-util + gen latency. ping me in thread if you want escalation.
maria: thanks everyone. Starting staging dry run 21:00 UTC. Will update thread with canary results. :thumbsup:
